name: Shrinking (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
Price +1 Bonus; Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

A shrinking weapon can reduce to the size of a charm of the type normally worn on a bracelet or necklace.

Commanding the item to shrink is a standard action.

A second command word (a swift action) causes the charm to return to its original size and, if you have a free hand, it appears in your hand and is ready to be used.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +1 Bonus; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells shrink item
